statement: Cineplex 21 said attendance drops 30 to 40 percent during Ramadan, also on weekends, because people go home early to break the fast and rest before dawn.
GPBSI chair said the industry relies on Eid and year-end holidays, and school breaks do not affect occupancy much because families spend on uniforms and supplies for the new school year.
Cinema XXI had more than 14 million admissions in April 2025 (Lebaran), a monthly record; the previous record was 11.7 million in June 2019.
Cinema XXI had about 8 million admissions in May 2025, about 22 million over April and May together.
Cinema XXI had 25 million admissions in the second quarter of 2024.
Cinema XXI had 84 million admissions in 2024 and targeted 95 million for 2025.

Cinema XXI ticket revenue fell 30 percent year on year to Rp582 billion in Q1 2025; moviegoing dropped in March 2025 (Ramadan) compared with usual days, and April 2025 admissions were already close to the whole Q1 total.
speaker_or_source: Cinema XXI (CNMA), reported by Indo Premier

statement: Cinema XXI had five films above 1 million admissions in Q1 2025 against seven in Q1 2024.
